rows.note: Use this as the everyday all-purpose choice when someone is unaware of a fact or situation.

example.english: I am ignorant of whether he took leave today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 gam1 jat6 ceng2 zo2 gaa2

rows.note: Use this to describe someone as generally unknowledgeable or uneducated rather than simply unaware of one fact.

example.english: They are ignorant about computers and do not even know how to turn one on.
example.traditional: 佢對電腦真係無知，連開機都唔識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 mou4 zi1 lin4 hoi1 gei1 dou1 m4 sik1

rows.note: Use this when “ignorant” means rude or lacking basic manners.

example.english: That was ignorant of you to speak to an elderly person like that.
example.traditional: 你咁樣對老人家講嘢，真係冇禮貌。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 deoi3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 gong2 je5 zan1 hai6 mou5 lai5 maau6
